title: Gemini moves to 2.5 Pro Experimental
summary:
Gemini got a new model behind its familiar name, text models gained aliases, and responses shed some unwanted links.

The `gemini` text model now maps to Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental through Vertex AI, replacing Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview.

Text model lookup now accepts defined aliases as well as primary names. DeepSeek reasoning mappings and persona model configurations were also updated.

The text server no longer adds NSFW referral links to generated responses. `/openai/models` now returns smaller OpenAI-style records that identify each model’s provider; richer error logging should help diagnose provider failures.

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental
highlights.text: Requests using `gemini` now map to Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental instead of Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

highlights.title: Aliases for text models
highlights.text: Text model requests can use defined aliases alongside primary model names. An included demo maps `gpt4` to `openai-large`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
